profile.name: Sophea
profile.bio: Detail-oriented and motivated accounting professional with 1 year of experience in accounting and financial operations. Skilled in recording transactions, preparing financial reports, managing invoices, reconciling accounts, and supporting daily accounting activities. I am passionate about accuracy, organization, and continuous professional growth in the accounting field.

experiences.description: Managing daily financial operations and reporting.
Assisted in payroll and tax preparation.

Operated cash register, processed customer payments (cash, card, mobile), and issued receipts accurately. Managed ticket sales, arcade credits, and game tokens while ensuring smooth customer flow. Provided friendly customer service, answered inquiries, and explained game rules or promotions. Balanced cash drawer daily, recorded transactions, and reported discrepancies. Assisted in maintaining a clean, safe, and fun environment for all guests.

education.description: Graduated with Honors. Specialized in Corporate Finance and Advanced Taxation.
Focused on Mathematics and Economics, graduating top of the class.

projects.title: Financial Reporting Dashboard
projects.description: Created a comprehensive financial reporting dashboard to visualize monthly revenue, expenses, and profit margins. Automated data entry processes to reduce manual errors by 95%.
